description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate AWS S3 storage interactions to Azure Blob Storage in both the web and worker modules.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses AWS S3 for storing uploaded assets and generated thumbnails. Migrating to Azure Blob Storage removes the AWS dependency and aligns with the Azure-first architecture.
tasks.requirements: Migrate all S3 operations (upload, list, download, delete) in the web module and the file read/write operations for thumbnail generation in the worker module to use Azure Blob Storage. Use Managed Identity for authentication. Remove the AWS SDK dependency and AWS credential configuration from both modules.

tasks.description: Migrate RabbitMQ (AMQP) messaging to Azure Service Bus in both the web and worker modules.
tasks.reason: The application uses RabbitMQ for asynchronous image-processing message exchange between the web and worker modules. Migrating to Azure Service Bus provides a fully managed, cloud-native messaging service and removes the RabbitMQ dependency.
tasks.requirements: Migrate message publishing (web module) and message consuming (worker module) from RabbitMQ with AMQP to Azure Service Bus. The existing image-processing queue/topic semantics must be preserved. Use Managed Identity for authentication. Remove the Spring AMQP RabbitMQ dependency and RabbitMQ connection configuration from both modules.

tasks.description: Migrate PostgreSQL database connectivity to Azure Database for PostgreSQL using Managed Identity in both the web and worker modules.
tasks.reason: The application currently connects to PostgreSQL using plain-text username and password credentials. Migrating to Azure Database for PostgreSQL with Managed Identity eliminates credential management risk and provides secure, credential-free authentication.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the data source configuration in both the web and worker modules from password-based authentication to Azure Database for PostgreSQL with Managed Identity. Remove plain-text database credentials from application.properties. Ensure Spring Data JPA and Hibernate continue to function correctly against Azure Database for PostgreSQL.
